ValidationRule.description: All Users can not change the drive date when the opportunity status is Cancelled. Except System Admin.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(sked_Status__c , 'Complete'), NOT($Profile.Name = 'System Administrator'), ISCHANGED(sked_Drive_Date__c) ) || AND( ISPICKVAL(sked_Status__c , 'Cancel'), NOT($Profile.Name = 'System Administrator'), ISCHANGED(sked_Drive_Date__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Drive Date cannot be changed on a completed/cancelled Drive.
